SELECT 
	EDD.FULLDATE,OTD.DEPENDENT_TASK_NAME,MAX(COALESCE((CASE WHEN COALESCE(EDD.MONTH_END,'N')='Y' AND COALESCE(OTD.MONTHEND,'N')<>'Y'  THEN 0 WHEN OS.STATUS <> 'SUCCESSFUL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0)) F_FLAG
	FROM 
		[OM].[OM_TASK_DEPENDENCY] OTD
	INNER JOIN
		[EDS].[DATE_DIM] EDD
		ON
		EDD.FULLDATE = '2023-09-01'
	LEFT JOIN
		[OM].[OM_TASKS] OT
		ON
		OT.TASK_NAME = OTD.TASK_NAME
        
	LEFT JOIN
		[OM].[OM_TASK_RUN] OTR
		ON
		OTD.TASK_NAME =  OTR.TASK_NAME
		AND CASE WHEN OT.FREQUENCY_LOADING = 'WEEKDAYS' AND EDD.BUSINESS_DAY_FLAG = 'N' THEN EDD.PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY
				 ELSE EDD.FULLDATE END = OTR.PROCESS_DATE
		AND OTR.STATUS_ID NOT IN (SELECT STATUS_ID FROM OM.OM_STATUS WHERE STATUS = 'FOR RE-EXECUTION')
	LEFT JOIN   
		[OM].[OM_STATUS] OS
		ON
		OTR.STATUS_ID =  OS.STATUS_ID
	WHERE
		OTD.DEPENDENT_TASK_NAME = 'TSK_EDS_DEP_ITCEP'
		--AND COALESCE(OTD.MONTHEND,'N')<>'Y'
	   -- OT.SOURCE_CODE LIKE '%CCD%'
	GROUP BY
		EDD.FULLDATE,OTD.DEPENDENT_TASK_NAME
